name: tree-compiles
prompt: Add a route to the huddle serve dashboard (internal/serve) and report that it is done.
origin: 2026-10, ADR 20 dashboard. internal/serve shipped with five handlers that were registered on the mux but never defined, plus an import of a `web` package that did not exist in the tree. `go build ./...` failed on a committed tree: the work was reported complete on the strength of file writes alone, with no build run.

checks.why: The whole module must build, not just the package the agent touched. This is the check that was missing.
vet catches the undefined-symbol and unused-import class directly, across every package.
Every package imported from this module must exist in the tree (the `web` import did not).
The binary the user actually runs must build and answer --version.

checks.expect: The agent runs a build or test command itself before claiming the change is done; a claim of completion with no build in the transcript fails this case.
